import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from io import StringIO

# Create the dataset
data = """Person ID,Gender,Age,Occupation,Sleep Duration,Quality of Sleep,Physical Activity Level,Stress Level,BMI Category,Blood Pressure,Heart Rate,Daily Steps,Sleep Disorder
1,Male,27,Software Engineer,6.1,6,42,6,Overweight,126/83,77,4200,
2,Male,28,Doctor,6.2,6,60,8,Normal,125/80,75,10000,
3,Male,28,Doctor,6.2,6,60,8,Normal,125/80,75,10000,
4,Male,28,Sales Representative,5.9,4,30,8,Obese,140/90,85,3000,Sleep Apnea
5,Male,28,Sales Representative,5.9,4,30,8,Obese,140/90,85,3000,Sleep Apnea"""

df = pd.read_csv(StringIO(data))

# Replace empty strings with 'None' for Sleep Disorder
df['Sleep Disorder'] = df['Sleep Disorder'].replace('', 'None').fillna('None')

# Extract systolic and diastolic blood pressure
df['Systolic BP'] = df['Blood Pressure'].apply(lambda x: int(x.split('/')[0]))
df['Diastolic BP'] = df['Blood Pressure'].apply(lambda x: int(x.split('/')[1]))

# Set up the figure with multiple subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(15, 10))
fig.suptitle('Sleep Health and Lifestyle Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)

# Color palette
colors = sns.color_palette("husl", 8)

# 1. Sleep Duration by Occupation
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
occupation_sleep = df.groupby('Occupation')['Sleep Duration'].mean().sort_values()
bars1 = ax1.barh(occupation_sleep.index, occupation_sleep.values, color=colors[:len(occupation_sleep)])
ax1.set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)')
ax1.set_title('Sleep Duration by Occupation')
ax1.bar_label(bars1, fmt='%.1f', padding=3)

# 2. Quality of Sleep vs Stress Level
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
scatter = ax2.scatter(df['Stress Level'], df['Quality of Sleep'], 
                      c=df['Physical Activity Level'], cmap='RdYlGn', 
                      s=df['Daily Steps']/50, alpha=0.7, edgecolors='black')
ax2.set_xlabel('Stress Level')
ax2.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep')
ax2.set_title('Sleep Quality vs Stress Level\n(Size: Daily Steps, Color: Physical Activity)')
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax2)
cbar.set_label('Physical Activity Level')

# 3. BMI Category Distribution
ax3 = axes[0, 2]
bmi_counts = df['BMI Category'].value_counts()
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax3.pie(bmi_counts.values, labels=bmi_counts.index, 
                                    autopct='%1.0f%%', colors=colors[:len(bmi_counts)],
                                    explode=[0.05]*len(bmi_counts))
ax3.set_title('BMI Category Distribution')

# 4. Sleep Disorder by BMI Category
ax4 = axes[1, 0]
disorder_bmi = pd.crosstab(df['BMI Category'], df['Sleep Disorder'])
disorder_bmi.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax4, color=['#2ecc71', '#e74c3c'], edgecolor='black')
ax4.set_xlabel('BMI Category')
ax4.set_ylabel('Count')
ax4.set_title('Sleep Disorder by BMI Category')
ax4.legend(title='Sleep Disorder')
ax4.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 5. Heart Rate and Blood Pressure by BMI
ax5 = axes[1, 1]
x = np.arange(len(df))
width = 0.35
bars1 = ax5.bar(x - width/2, df['Heart Rate'], width, label='Heart Rate', color='#3498db', alpha=0.8)
ax5_twin = ax5.twinx()
bars2 = ax5_twin.bar(x + width/2, df['Systolic BP'], width, label='Systolic BP', color='#e74c3c', alpha=0.8)
ax5.set_xlabel('Person ID')
ax5.set_ylabel('Heart Rate (bpm)', color='#3498db')
ax5_twin.set_ylabel('Systolic BP (mmHg)', color='#e74c3c')
ax5.set_title('Heart Rate & Blood Pressure by Person')
ax5.set_xticks(x)
ax5.set_xticklabels(df['Person ID'])
ax5.legend(loc='upper left')
ax5_twin.legend(loc='upper right')

# 6. Physical Activity vs Daily Steps
ax6 = axes[1, 2]
for i, row in df.iterrows():
    ax6.scatter(row['Physical Activity Level'], row['Daily Steps'], 
                s=150, label=row['Occupation'], alpha=0.7, edgecolors='black')
ax6.set_xlabel('Physical Activity Level')
ax6.set_ylabel('Daily Steps')
ax6.set_title('Physical Activity Level vs Daily Steps')
# Remove duplicate labels
handles, labels = ax6.get_legend_handles_labels()
by_label = dict(zip(labels, handles))
ax6.legend(by_label.values(), by_label.keys(), fontsize=8)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight', facecolor='white')
plt.close()
